title.en: Granting of Cash Reward to Persons Instrumental in the Discovery and Seizure of Foreign Currencies Being Smuggled Out of the Country

text.en:
That persons not in the government or the Armed Forces of the Philippines giving information
leading to the discovery and seizure of convertible foreign currencies being smuggled out of the country shall
be entitled to a cash reward equivalent to twenty (20%) per centum of the total amount of the currency seized.

All laws, acts, decrees, orders, and regulations inconsistent herewith are deemed repealed and/or
modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect upon its approval.
Done in the City of Manila, this 30th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
